versions.changelog:
Initial release of 参考文献批量处理 (reference-batch):

- Input paper titles, DOIs, or author info to batch-generate reference lists in GB/T 7714, APA, MLA, and more formats.
- Auto-recognition of document type: journal, thesis, conference, book, web, etc.; outputs complete, well-structured citations for each.
- Handles multiple entries pasted at once—title, author, DOI, or mixed; fields auto-mapped and missing data flagged “待补”.
- Outputs clear, directly-copyable reference lists for each requested format; includes multi-format comparison if needed.
- No made-up citation fields; reminders for users to fill in or check missing info.
- Supports reformatting messy entries; adapts to user requirements for citation format and field precision.
